digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate, CI workflow voting
propositions: Cancelled or timed-out mutation jobs cast Verified -1 with a canned 'CANCELLED: <url>' message that carries no job name, reason, or test signal, forcing manual triage via job URL inspection.

The gerrit-review-action hardcodes message as '${STATUS}: ${URL}' with no input for custom text, and its comment-only flag is a label switch not a message switch, so enrichment must occur via a separate post-vote comment.

A timed-out job is distinguished from arbitrary cancellation only through GitHub check-run annotations stating 'exceeded the maximum execution time', which are not accessible to the aggregating vote step.

A dedicated summarize_ci_failures.py script maps job list plus per-job annotations to one-line summaries naming the job, duration, and outcome (TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED) for posting via raw SSH gerrit review --message after the vote is cast.

The comment step must sanitize job names by stripping single quotes, backslashes, and control characters except newline to prevent escape of the remote command's quoting, and both new steps are continue-on-error and guarded on vote-type != 'success' so they cannot redden a passing run.
